items.title: Dorothy Tait Interview, 1968-12-21
items.q: And then, I guess, the others, as I recall, it was... Jim Robinson or Kit Howard. Oh, yes. Jim Robinson and Kit Howard. That's true.

ctx.x: Because he was not in good health. He was in very frail health. And he had to sleep in the daytime and, uh, uh, get all the sleep. And I always tried to see if we couldn't work it that way. Drag and, uh, well, Drag and Joe Watkins always shared the room. Mm-hm. And let me see, uh, Elton Bernal. Well, then it just, but it was pretty standard, the Drag and, that Drag and Joe. Mm-hm. And George, whenever we possibly could, I'm trying to get him a room to himself. And then, I guess, the others, as I recall, it was...…
